publication_underspecified: Source record reports missing or ambiguous publication inputs; exact-replay limits do not establish a wrong physical conclusion.
paper_claim_discrepancy: Publication-side discrepancy attribution retained at its recorded confidence; not newly confirmed as a paper error.
system_capability_limit: Current implementation or method does not establish the original target; this does not necessarily identify a code bug.
reproduction_method_gap: Current method lacks the scientific object or proof required by the target.
scope_definition_gap: The chosen reproduction scope does not establish the full target.
review_or_evidence_process_gap: Workflow evidence or review is incomplete; no numerical fault inferred.
unresolved: Agent workflow must reconcile the old diagnostic record; this assigns record maintenance, not the physical mismatch, to Agent.
compute_capacity_shortfall: Declared full-scale campaign exceeds completed resource allocation; an unexecuted job alone is not used to infer compute shortage.
external_dependency_unavailable: Source access, software licensing or an unattested computing platform is not automatically a paper defect, compute shortage or missing experimental apparatus.

equipment_status: No standalone equipment-unavailability attribution is established by this diagnostic extraction; missing calibration arrays do not prove missing apparatus. Blank is not zero.
source_material_access_warning: Unavailable supplements and missing external datasets remain unallocated unless a source audit identifies a publication omission.
